steps: Slide or unclip the metal grease filter from the hood.
Wash it in hot soapy water or run it through the dishwasher.
Replace charcoal/carbon filters (non-washable) per the manufacturer's schedule.
Wipe down the hood interior while the filter is out.
Reinstall the filter, ensuring it clicks/seats fully.
